description: Synthetic DERA FSDS archive request plan for the fixture-replay acquisition tests (ADR-082). The two ZIPs beside this plan carry sub.txt members byte-identical to the committed dera_fsds fixture TSVs, so acquisition followed by dera-validate must reproduce the ADR-081 gold. The url_template is a candidate only: no request is ever made to it from fixtures, and the real path is verified by the separately authorized live canary.
observed_through_basis: Deliberately conservative fixture value inside the loaded 2023q1 release so the right_boundary_unobserved category is exercised in gold; see the dera_fsds fixture rationale (ADR-081).
